summary: Per-role totals reconcile exactly to the recomputed charge on all 28 metered sessions, across all three role kinds the study needs - primary (27 sessions), finder (1) and verifier, metered as 'worker' (2) - with no session left unassigned. Every charged figure is the larger of the self-report and the recomputed total, and each difference is named by the untranscripted Haiku request. What is missing is the other half P18 asks for.
establishes: That settlement supplies a role for every transcript and that the per-role split sums to the total, on real transcripts, at the study's own rate card. No role defaulted to primary and none was priced at zero.
residual: Two gaps, and one of them is gap-2's own open question. (1) No provider error occurred in this bundle, so the filtered-copy path - copies carrying explicit labels from their original inputs, a sources.json mapping with source and copy digests, per-copy directories so equal basenames cannot overwrite each other, and resolution to the source before pricing - is exercised only by the synthetic tests. It cannot be forced; a freeze must either wait for one or accept that the path is untested against a real provider error. (2) U5 is still open: every verifier session is metered as 'worker', so a study that wants verification cost by ordinal - initial against follow-up - needs finer attribution than the coordinator currently supplies, and the freeze must either add it or state that the analysis does not distinguish them. The earlier run of this probe, published at the reviewed head, is retained under run-1/; this run re-used its exact command against the reconciliation report after that report's keys became bundle-relative paths.
read_from: the probe's own retained output, not asserted beside it
